verdict.rationale: Core browser sessions can be created, controlled, and observed programmatically through the official SDK. Webhook endpoints are explicitly managed from either Settings or the SDK, and files are retrievable via a Downloads API. However, several features are documented only in the dashboard: Agent creation is described as dashboard-driven, and the Optimize tool "lives in the Agent run view in the dashboard", which undercuts full UI/API parity. Missing for 10: a documented parity guarantee across all features, API equivalents for dashboard-only Agent creation and Optimize, and a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
